_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Cal 3 now completes its five-second resting countdown reliably when the syringe stops. Isolated NI-DAQ sample noise no longer repeatedly restarts the timer; sustained flow or renewed movement restarts all five seconds. The live graph shows the actual rest band with solid lines and the stroke-start threshold with dashed lines.

Flow calibration always fits independent Kp and Kn from each direction's mean whole-stroke nominal volume. Every raw flow sample remains integrated on the NI-DAQ clock. Stored calibration is preserved until a complete reviewed result passes the existing save and read-back gates.

Validated by recorded-trace replay, 500 Hz noisy-tail and renewed-motion tests, volume/timebase checks, and full offline application checks. Valinor firmware and Max 80 through Max 220 presets are unchanged. Physical syringe accuracy requires a new operator calibration.
